purpose: make sure the service can be restored after a major loss, within agreed recovery time and data-loss limits, and prove it
entry_criteria: Recovery time objective and recovery point objective are agreed for the service
procedure: Identify critical components and their dependencies; define recovery order.
Document and automate recovery steps where possible; keep the runbook current.
Run a recovery exercise in an isolated environment or a controlled production test; record recovery time and data-loss window.
Compare measured RTO and RPO with the targets; list gaps.
Fix gaps or get the DR owner to accept the risk with an expiry.
Schedule the next exercise and record results.
deliverables: exercise report with measured RTO and RPO
acceptance_criteria: Measured RTO and RPO meet targets or gaps are accepted
Runbook worked as written or was corrected
validation_method: DR-owner approval after a recorded exercise.

validation.check: restore the latest backup into an isolated environment and time it
compare newest restored record timestamp with the failure time

failure_modes.response: Run a restore test before approval
Improve or formally accept the gap

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A regional failover exercise restores the database in 18 minutes with 40 seconds of data loss against targets of 30 minutes and 5 minutes; one runbook step is corrected.
